answer: Proof of Agent enforces quadratic stake burning for concurrent identities: an agent must burn B(k) = c * k^2 base tokens via a verifiable cipher commitment before executing tasks. If an adversary attempts to mirror a single agent across k hollow replicas, the marginal cost scales superlinearly, d/dk[B(k)] = 2ck. This economic friction makes multi-identity spoofing mathematically unprofitable, as payoff grows linearly while identity cost explodes exponentially.
